name: Haus Tonin
beschreibung: Haus Tonin welcomes guests right in the centre of the charming village of Fulpmes in the scenic Stubaital Valley. This welcoming alpine guesthouse combines authentic Tyrolean hospitality with comfortable guest rooms equipped with private bathrooms and television. The rustic dining parlour serves regional Tyrolean culinary specialities in a warm atmosphere. Thanks to its central location, local shops and the valley station of the Schlick 2000 hiking and ski centre are reached within a pleasant short stroll. The Stubai Glacier is easily accessible via the regular local ski bus, while summer invites alpine hikes and cycling through the surrounding valley.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine guesthouse in the village centre of Fulpmes in the Stubaital with a cosy parlour.
